xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-cg:DisclosureOfNotesOnCommitteeTe: Shri Raj Kumar Mangla ceased to be the Chairperson of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee w.e.f. 01-03-2024.
Shri Laxman Tamanna Tapashi was redesignated as the Chairperson of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee w.e.f. 01.03.2024.
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-cg:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfBoardC: As on 31.03.2024, RITES had 4 Executive Directors (including Chairperson), 2 Non-Executive Nominee Directors and 4 Non-Executive Independent Directors. RITES, being a Govt. Company within the meaning of Section 2 (45) of the Companies Act, 2013, the power to appoint Executive Directors, Non-Executive Nominee Directors and Independent Directors vests with the President of India (through Ministry of Railways).
